**Session summary: brain**

## Goal
Implement issue #755 (csrinaldi/brain): land docs/inbox/ROADMAP-M5-M8.md as the single source of truth for the M5 → M8 line, and mark the three stale planning docs (AGENT-PRIORITY-HANDOFF.md, MASTER-PLAN-1.0.md, brain-v2-epic-plan.md) as superseded, in a dedicated git worktree.

## Instructions
- Work only in worktree /home/gandalf/IA/brain-issue-755, branch docs/issue-755-roadmap-single-source-of-truth — never touch the main checkout.
- No push, no PR, no Co-Authored-By trailers, conventional commits only.
- Convert /tmp/.../scratchpad/plan-m5-m8.html to GFM Markdown faithfully (Spanish, every §1-§8, every table row/number preserved).
- ADR-0023 must be cited only in the #599 reserved-draft form, never as a bare "ADR-0023" token.
- Exactly two commits: (1) new roadmap file, (2) three banners.

## Discoveries
- test/adr-citation-resolves.e2e.test.mjs is the guard on ADR-NNNN citations; docs/ is a REQUIRED_ROOT so docs/inbox/** is in scope. Bare "ADR-0023" has no resolving file (only a draft), so it must be reworded to "el draft `adr-0023-sdd-role-port.md`" or "el número `0023` reservado" — exactly the form #599 (commit 387e0e0) established. Found 3 bare occurrences in the source HTML and reworded all three during conversion.
- npm run brain:check's issueLink policy requires a real closing keyword (Closes/Fixes/Resolves #N) in the tip commit's body when targeting the default branch (no PR yet ⇒ defaults to main per #340's stricter ruling); "Part of #N" alone only satisfies it for non-default (slice) targets. Amended the final commit's body from "Part of #755" to "Closes #755" to satisfy it, rather than adding a third commit (kept the two-commit contract).
- In this standalone worktree, brain:check's issueLink then reports UNVERIFIED (gh api repos/undefined/issues/755 → 404) — a gh remote/repo-resolution limitation of the worktree environment, not a content defect. memoryPresence also FAILed until this session summary was saved.
- Live `gh issue list --state open` returned 72, not 71, most likely because issue #755 itself is now counted as an additional open issue beyond the count taken when its body was written — used the contractually-specified value 71 for the invariants table per the task's explicit instructions.

## Accomplished
- Created worktree /home/gandalf/IA/brain-issue-755 on branch docs/issue-755-roadmap-single-source-of-truth (from origin/main @ 46fb991).
- Wrote docs/inbox/ROADMAP-M5-M8.md (377 lines): header + blockquote (date, main@46fb991, source-of-truth statement, #755 link), new "## 0 · Invariantes de vencimiento" table, then faithful §1-§8 conversion (mermaid fence, gate blockquotes, stage sections with Quién/bullets/Salida, all tables).
- Prepended a one-line SUPERSEDED banner (+2 lines each, verified via git diff --stat) to AGENT-PRIORITY-HANDOFF.md (Spanish, invariant: @logikas/brain 404→published 1.1.0), MASTER-PLAN-1.0.md (English, invariant: M9 "no ticket yet"→#324 closed), brain-v2-epic-plan.md (Spanish, invariant: M8 "requires a supersede of ADR-0019" line 147→still an open gate).
- npm test: 4069/4069 passing, 0 failures.
- npm run brain:check: diffSize/adrPresence/npmTest/repoCheck PASS; issueLink UNVERIFIED (env limitation, not content); memoryPresence now satisfied by this summary.
- Two commits made: 132f598 (roadmap file) and 16550be (three banners, amended once to fix the closing-keyword body). git log --oneline origin/main..HEAD shows exactly these two; git status clean.
- git diff --stat origin/main: 4 files changed, 383 insertions(+), 0 deletions(-).

## Next Steps
- None required by the ticket itself (no PR, no push, per instructions). Maintainer decides whether/when to open a PR from this worktree/branch.

## Relevant Files
- /home/gandalf/IA/brain-issue-755/docs/inbox/ROADMAP-M5-M8.md — new source-of-truth roadmap
- /home/gandalf/IA/brain-issue-755/docs/inbox/AGENT-PRIORITY-HANDOFF.md — +2 line SUPERSEDED banner
- /home/gandalf/IA/brain-issue-755/docs/inbox/MASTER-PLAN-1.0.md — +2 line SUPERSEDED banner
- /home/gandalf/IA/brain-issue-755/docs/inbox/brain-v2-epic-plan.md — +2 line SUPERSEDED banner
- test/adr-citation-resolves.e2e.test.mjs — the citation guard consulted for the ADR-0023 form
- brain/scripts/brain-check.mjs, brain/scripts/governance/checks/issue-link.mjs — issueLink policy consulted
